snippet.title: Mugen Souls Z [GAMEPLAY] - PS3
snippet.description:
Mugen Souls Z gameplay from PS3.
Mugen Souls Z gameplay without comment.
#nocommentary

Mugen Souls Z is the second part of the jRPG cycle started in 2012 with Mugen Souls. Developers from Compile Heart studio remained faithful to the jRPG genre enriched with strategic elements as well as anime style. As in the original, the plot Mugen Souls Z presents a very twisted story with many humorous accents. Players will get to know further adventures of Lady Chou-Chou, who has lost most of her strength due to her greed. However, she managed to transfer the rest of her power into the body of the clumsy goddess Sylma. The heroine, whose actions are directed by the player, together with her faithful companions has to face the hordes of Shampurus awakened from sleep.
